rider.title: Tech Rider
rider.intro: Four musicians on acoustic instruments: three kamale n'goni stations, djembe, calabash, and a dundun set of three drums. Channel numbers below match the stage plot and input list.

needs.detail: 3 minimum, one per kamale n'goni. 6 if available, so each n'goni can run a second DI.
5 vocal mics on boom stands: one at each n'goni station, one at the djembe, one at the calabash.
1 dynamic mic (SM57 or similar) on a short or low kick stand, placed low.
1 wired mic placed underneath the calabash shell, on a blanket on the band's table. Shure Beta 91A preferred; a kick mic also works well.
2 overhead mics on boom stands, stage left and stage right of the percussion pair.
2 overhead mics on boom stands, stage left and stage right of the dundun set, plus 1 kick-style low mic on a floor stand.
3 wedge mixes: W1 stage left, W2 center, W3 stage right.

rider.channelSummary: 18 channels total. Channels 2, 5 and 8 are optional secondary DIs and can be dropped on a smaller console, for a 15 channel minimum.
rider.bandProvides: The band brings all instruments, the calabash table, and the blanket. Everything above is requested from the venue.
rider.moreInfo: Stage plot, input list, and this rider are in the press kit at sanji.band/sanji-press-kit.html.
